about_the_game:
PLEASE NOTE: This game currently only supports Simplified Chinese.

A cultivation simulation game that blends strategic deck-building and Roguelite elements. Inspired by Towards Longevity's deep simulation of the path to immortality, the endless combo-building thrill of Balatro, and the refined strategic depth of Slay the Spire, our goal is to create a unique, heaven-defying ascension experience for players.

Here, you are not an omniscient god overseeing a sect, but a mortal with limited lifespan, struggling for survival. You will personally experience each realm from Qi Refining and Foundation Establishment to Mahayana, consuming your lifespan, manipulating the five elemental spiritual energies (Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth), and choosing from hundreds of techniques to comprehend. Utilize elixirs, magical treasures, formations, and talismans to overcome heavenly tribulations. The ultimate goal is singular: break the shackles of your lifespan and ascend to immortality.

Every breath you take could be a life-or-death decision.

Profound Yin-Yang & Five Elements Spiritual Energy System

We've integrated all gameplay into the core concept of "cultivation." You need to cycle the five elemental spiritual energies (Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth), combine them with Yin and Yang attributes, and unleash ever-changing spells like "Five Elements Rotation," "Pure Yang," and "Five Revolutions." Use strategy and wisdom to accumulate the capital needed for ascension.

Vast Array of Techniques for Free-form Deck Building

With over 135 techniques, along with various elixirs, magical treasures, talismans, and formations... these will be crucial aids on your path to immortality. You can create your own unique Dao.

Every "Cycle" and "Breath" is a Choice Between Life and Death

"Lifespan" is your most core resource. Each "Cycle" of energy and each "Breath" you take consumes your limited years. Will you choose a steady and solid approach, or burn your lifespan for immense power to break through bottlenecks in a single round? Your every decision directly impacts whether you will live to see another sunrise.

Endless Cycles, An Unpredictable Path

Each new run is a completely fresh journey towards immortality. Randomly assigned spiritual roots, technique rewards, and the ever-changing heavenly tribulations ensure that every ascension attempt is filled with unknowns and challenges. Clear higher difficulties and unlock permanent achievements, allowing you to progress further in your next reincarnation cycle.

Fellow Daoist, how much lifespan do you have left? Are you ready to embark on this heaven-defying path to ascension?
